question: Which public lung neoadjuvant IO scRNA/bulk datasets can recover (A) malignant TACSTD2 higher in NMPR than MPR and (B) per-patient TACSTD2 vs T/NK Spearman rho negative?
rules: Accessions were taken from GEO E-utilities or the four user-specified seeds. None were invented.
Only public processed matrices were used (GEO supplementary TSV/MTX/FPKM). No FASTQ.
pCR is grouped with MPR. Two-sided Mann-Whitney and one-sided NMPR>MPR are both reported.
scRNA malignant TACSTD2 uses epithelial cells (author Epi or EPCAM/KRT+ PTPRC-). Bulk/GeoMx are mixture proxies and are labeled as such.

findingB.note: n=4 after T/NK>=20 filter; T/NK fractions 0.2-2%; not interpretable as confirmation

GSE329813_geomx_tumorbed.caveat: GeoMx tumor-bed ROI is a mixture, not malignant-cell isolation

honest_answer.scRNA_malignant_TACSTD2_NMPR_gt_MPR: NOT recovered at p<0.05 in any tested scRNA series. GSE207422 matches direction (underpowered). GSE241934 (best n) is null/opposite. GSE291670 n=3v3 is opposite.
honest_answer.scRNA_perpatient_vs_TNK_negative: NOT recovered at p<0.05 in scRNA. GSE207422 rho=-0.26 p=0.34. GSE241934 rho~0. GSE291670 n=4 rho=-1 is not a real confirmation.
honest_answer.bulk_or_spatial_mixture: YES for Finding B in GSE207422 bulk and GSE248378 bulk. YES for both findings in GSE329813 GeoMx tumor-bed (mixture, not scRNA malignant).
